Biomarkers of nivolumab benefit in resectable non-small cell lung cancer
summary_zh: 研究显示nivolumab在可切除非小细胞肺癌中提高无事件生存期。通过分析ctDNA，发现nivolumab治疗患者的ctDNA水平更高。
summary_en: The study shows that nivolumab improves event-free survival in resectable non-small cell lung cancer. Analysis of ctDNA reveals higher ctDNA levels in patients treated with nivolumab.
insights: 创新点：发现nivolumab在肺癌治疗中的益处
方法亮点：利用ctDNA作为生物标志物
关键发现：nivolumab治疗患者ctDNA水平更高
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the benefit of nivolumab in lung cancer treatment
Method highlight: Use of ctDNA as a biomarker
Key finding: Higher ctDNA levels in patients treated with nivolumab
abstract: Perioperative nivolumab significantly improved event-free survival (EFS) compared with placebo in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in the CheckMate 77T study (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04025879 )1. Here, after randomization, 98 out of 229 patients who received nivolumab and 92 out of 232 patients who received placebo had evaluable biomarkers (41% of randomized patients). Of the 98 patients receiving nivolumab, 83 (85%) had detectable circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) before initiating neoadjuvant treatment and 90 (92%) at neoadjuvant treatment completion. Of the 92 placebo-treated patients, 75 (82%) had detectable ctDNA at the treatment start and 78 (85%) at completion. Among the 98 nivolumab-treated patients, 76 (78%) had detectable and evaluable ctDNA before and after neoadjuvant treatment, and 50 of them (66%) had pre-surgical ctDNA clearance, and 25 out of 50 (50%) had pathologic complete response (pCR). For the placebo-treated group, these values were 64 out 92 (70%) for detectable and evaluable ctDNA before and after neoadjuvant treatment, and 24 out of 64 (38%) had pre-surgical ctDNA clearance, and 3 out of 24 (12%) had pCR. Furthermore, 4 out of 48 (8%) patients in the nivolumab group and 9 out of 44 (20%) in the placebo group who were negative for molecular residual disease (MRD) after surgery and before adjuvant treatment initiation became positive during the adjuvant treatment period; all had disease recurrence. EFS seemed to be prolonged with nivolumab (n = 60) versus placebo (n = 45) in patients with single or co-alterations in any of the KEAP1, STK11, CDKN2A and/or SMARCA4 driver genes (hazard ratio, 0.48; 95% confidence interval, 0.28–0.83). In a machine-learning model trained using biomarker-evaluable patients, top predictors of prolonged EFS included pre-surgical ctDNA clearance, non-N2 NSCLC, pCR, squamous tumour histology and nivolumab treatment. These findings provide insights into predictive markers for outcomes with perioperative nivolumab in resectable NSCLC. Potential predictive biomarkers of perioperative nivolumab therapy benefit in non-small cell lung cancer are identified from evaluable participants in the CheckMate 77T trial.

title: Maternal influences on infant gut microbiome and health
summary_zh: 研究显示母亲肠道菌群对婴儿肠道菌群和健康有重要影响。通过纵向样本分析，发现母亲肠道菌群对婴儿肠道菌群有显著影响。
summary_en: The study shows that maternal gut microbiome has a significant impact on infant gut microbiome and health. Longitudinal sample analysis reveals a significant impact of maternal gut microbiome on infant gut microbiome.
insights: 创新点：发现母亲肠道菌群对婴儿肠道菌群的影响
方法亮点：利用纵向样本分析
关键发现：母亲肠道菌群是婴儿肠道菌群的主要来源
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the impact of maternal gut microbiome on infant gut microbiome
Method highlight: Use of longitudinal sample analysis
Key finding: Maternal gut microbiome is a major source of infant gut strains
abstract: Abstract The establishment of the infant gut microbiome is critical for later health 1,2 , yet how it is shaped by maternal and early-life factors remains unclear. Here we metagenomically sequenced 4,526 longitudinal faecal samples from 714 mother–infant pairs in the Dutch birth cohort Lifelines NEXT, spanning 12 weeks of pregnancy to 1 year postpartum. We integrated these data with 474 clinical and exposure variables, and with ultra-deep sequencing of breast milk and vaginal microbiomes. We observe that the maternal gut microbiome undergoes only subtle changes during pregnancy and postpartum, influenced by diet, infections and pre-pregnancy smoking. The maternal gut microbiome is a major reservoir for infant gut strains, with only occasional transmission from vaginal and breast milk microbiomes. Mother–infant gut strain sharing is time dependent, and higher maternal gut species abundance increases the likelihood of strain transmission. We find that the maternal gut microbiome is a predictor of infant eczema. Mode of delivery and feeding mode primarily shaped the infant gut microbiome and its functional profiles, with maternal exposures also having a role. Of 585 vaginally delivered infants, 155 were born at home, but home delivery was only moderately associated with infant gut microbiome composition, similar to other birth parameters such as duration of pushing and ruptured membranes. Overall, we highlight the central role of the mother and her microbiome in shaping the infant gut ecosystem and early health outcomes.

title: Identification and validation of a previously missed mutational signature in colorectal cancer
summary_zh: 研究揭示CRC中未被发现的突变特征SBS_D，通过独立分析证实其存在并可能被忽视。
summary_en: The study identifies and validates a previously missed mutational signature SBS_D in colorectal cancer, confirming its presence and potential oversight.
insights: 创新点：发现CRC中新的突变特征SBS_D
方法亮点：通过独立分析验证突变特征
关键发现：SBS_D可能被先前研究忽视
insights_en: Novelty: Discover a new mutational signature SBS_D in CRC
Method highlight: Validate the mutation signature through independent analysis
Key finding: SBS_D may have been overlooked in previous studies
abstract: ABSTRACT Mutational signature analysis has greatly enhanced our understanding of the mutagenic processes found in cancer and normal tissues. As part of a recent study, we analyzed 802 treatment-naïve, microsatellite-stable colorectal cancers (CRC) and identified a de novo signature, SBS_D, which was conservatively decomposed into SBS18, a signature associated with reactive oxygen species. Here, we re-evaluate this decomposition and provide evidence that SBS_D represents a distinct mutational process from that of SBS18. Through an independent analysis of 2,616 whole-genome sequenced microsatellite-stable CRCs across three distinct cohorts, we demonstrate that SBS_D is consistently present at a similar prevalence, suggesting that this signature may have been previously overlooked. Using a naïve decomposition approach, we demonstrate that the pattern of SBS_D better aligns with signatures previously associated with deficiencies in DNA polymerase delta (POLD1) proofreading and mismatch repair. However, multiple lines of evidence, including the absence of pathogenic mutations in the exonuclease domain of POLD1 or in mismatch repair-associated genes, indicate that SBS_D is not driven by canonical defects in these DNA repair pathways. Overall, this study identifies a previously unrecognized mutational signature in microsatellite-stable CRC and proposes that its etiology may be linked to DNA repair infidelity emerging late in tumor development in samples without canonical defects in DNA repair pathways.

title: Segment any tumour: an uncertainty-aware vision foundation model for whole-body analysis
summary_zh: 提出SAT3D模型，用于多种医学影像模态下的肿瘤分割，提高边界预测准确性。
summary_en: Proposes the SAT3D model for tumor segmentation across diverse medical imaging modalities, improving boundary prediction accuracy.
insights: 创新点：开发轻量级肿瘤分割模型SAT3D
方法亮点：集成shifted-window视觉Transformer和不确定性感知训练
关键发现：模型在多种影像模态下表现良好
insights_en: Novelty: Develop a lightweight tumor segmentation model SAT3D
Method highlight: Integrate shifted-window Vision Transformer and uncertainty-aware training
Key finding: The model performs well across various imaging modalities
abstract: Prompt-driven vision foundation models, such as the Segment Anything Model, have shown adaptability in computer vision, but their use in medical imaging remains challenging due to heterogeneous anatomy, artefacts, and low-contrast tumour boundaries. This is particularly difficult in whole-body tumour analysis, where models must transfer across modalities, anatomies, and tumour appearances. Here, we present Segment Any Tumour 3D (SAT3D), a lightweight volumetric foundation model for generalisable tumour segmentation across diverse medical imaging modalities, organs, and cohorts. SAT3D integrates a shifted-window vision transformer with critic-guided uncertainty-aware training, using confidence maps as dense prompts to guide boundary prediction in ambiguous regions. We benchmark SAT3D against vision foundation models, prompt-driven and task-specific methods across 11 public datasets. Trained on 17,075 three-dimensional volume-mask pairs, SAT3D shows robust generalisation, including in out-of-distribution settings, and is supported by a 3D-Slicer plugin for interactive segmentation, underscoring SAT3D’s potential as a scalable foundation model for medical image analysis. The application of prompt-driven vision foundation models to medical imaging, particularly whole-body tumour analysis, remains challenging. Here, the authors develop Segment Any Tumour 3D (SAT3D), a lightweight volumetric foundation model for robust and generalisable tumour segmentation across diverse medical imaging modalities, organs, and cohorts.

title: A foundation model for acute abdomen diagnosis stratification and triage on noncontrast computed tomography
summary_zh: 本文提出AbdomenNet，基于自监督基础模型的多任务AI系统，用于非对比CT图像的急性腹部疾病诊断和风险分层。系统在103,989例NCCT检查上预训练，并在5,816个标注病例上微调。评估了其在三个独立队列中的泛化能力，并估计了工作流程的影响。
summary_en: This paper introduces AbdomenNet, a multi-task AI system based on a self-supervised foundation model for diagnosing acute abdominal conditions and performing risk stratification from NCCT images. The system is pretrained on 103,989 NCCT scans and fine-tuned on 5,816 annotated cases. Its generalizability across three independent external cohorts is assessed, and the impact on workflow is estimated.
insights: 创新点：基于自监督基础模型的多任务AI系统
方法亮点：在大量NCCT图像上预训练和微调
关键发现：系统在独立队列中表现出良好的泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Multi-task AI system based on a self-supervised foundation model
Method highlight: Pretrained and fine-tuned on a large dataset of NCCT images
Key finding: The system demonstrates good generalizability in independent cohorts
abstract: Accurate and timely diagnosis of acute abdominal emergencies remains challenging. Non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) is often used as an initial imaging modality because of atypical presentations, contraindications to contrast, or resource constraints. Here we present AbdomenNet, a multi-task AI system built on a self-supervised foundation model that detects 11 acute abdominal conditions and performs three risk-stratification subtasks from NCCT images. AbdomenNet is pre-trained on 103,989 NCCT examinations and fine-tuned on 5816 annotated cases. We assess generalizability in 2528 patients from three independent external cohorts, evaluate radiologist performance in a multi-reader multi-case crossover study, and estimate workflow impact using retrospective reconstruction. In external validation, AbdomenNet achieves a macro-average AUROC of 0.919 for five emergent conditions. AI assistance increases radiologists’ mean AUROC from 0.812 to 0.924 and reduces median reading time by 52.5 seconds per case. Workflow reconstruction indicates that AI-driven prioritization could shorten median report turnaround time by 37 minutes. The authors present AbdomenNet, a foundation model for non-contrast computed tomography. It detects 11 acute abdominal conditions, helps identify high-risk cases, improves radiologist accuracy, and may speed emergency reporting.

title: Clinical translation and engineering challenges of soft robotic cardiac sleeves for heart failure
summary_zh: 综述探讨软体心脏袖套在心力衰竭中的应用，分析其生理基础、技术进展和临床转化挑战。
summary_en: This review discusses the application of soft robotic cardiac sleeves in heart failure, analyzing their physiological basis, technological advancements, and clinical translation challenges.
insights: 创新点：提出软体心脏袖套在心力衰竭中的应用
方法亮点：综述软体机器人技术进展
关键发现：临床转化面临工程挑战
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing the application of soft robotic cardiac sleeves in heart failure
Method highlight: Reviewing advancements in soft robotics technology
Key finding: Engineering challenges in clinical translation
abstract: Soft robotic cardiac sleeves are an emerging class of non-blood-contact mechanical circulatory support devices designed to augment myocardial function while avoiding direct interaction with blood. Their development addresses important limitations of conventional heart failure therapies and offers a promising strategy for physiological cardiac assistance. This Review examines the pathophysiological basis for sleeve-assisted cardiac support, recent advances in soft robotic technologies, and the key engineering and translational challenges that must be overcome for clinical implementation. Finally, we propose a translational framework to guide the future development of clinically viable soft robotic cardiac sleeves. Heart failure remains a major cause of death despite advances in mechanical circulatory support. Here, the authors review soft robotic cardiac sleeves and define the key engineering, biological and translational challenges that must be addressed for successful clinical adoption.

title: Contrast-enhanced CT Radiomics for High-Grade Pattern Identification and Prognostic Stratification in Lung Adenocarcinoma with Consolidation-to-Tumor Ratio of 25% or More | Tweetorial
Synthetic sequence alignments as programmable probes of learned conformational landscapes in deep learning protein structure predictors
summary_zh: 研究提出利用合成序列比对作为深度学习蛋白质结构预测器中学习到的构象景观的可编程探针。实验发现合成序列比对系统性地偏斜蛋白质折叠转换蛋白的构象状态。模型预测合成序列比对在结构预测系统中的应用潜力。
summary_en: Research proposes using synthetic sequence alignments as programmable probes of learned conformational landscapes in deep learning protein structure predictors. Experiments show that synthetic sequence alignments systematically bias the conformational states of fold-switching proteins. Models predict the potential application of synthetic sequence alignments in structure prediction systems.
insights: 创新点：合成序列比对在蛋白质结构预测中的应用
方法亮点：利用逆折叠设计合成序列比对
关键发现：合成序列比对在蛋白质结构预测中的系统偏斜作用
insights_en: Novelty: Application of synthetic sequence alignments in protein structure prediction
Method highlight: Utilizing inverse folding to design synthetic sequence alignments
Key finding: Systematic biasing effect of synthetic sequence alignments in protein structure prediction
abstract: MOTIVATION: Proteins rely on conformational flexibility for biological function, yet predicting alternative states remains a major challenge in structural biology. Although deep learning models like AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, and RoseTTAFold2 excel at static structure prediction, what these networks actually learn about underlying conformational landscapes remains largely opaque. RESULTS: Here we introduce synthetic multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), designed by inverse folding to encode predefined structural constraints, as a programmable intervention for interrogating the internal logic of structure prediction systems. Synthetic MSAs systematically bias AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, and RoseTTAFold2 toward distinct conformational states of fold-switching proteins, including alternative conformations inaccessible through natural sequence information alone. Adversarial experiments pairing query sequences with MSAs encoding competing folds reveal sequence-dependent responses, exposing how alignment-derived and sequence-derived signals are weighted within each system. Probing predictions initialized from molecular dynamics trajectories reveals a systematic bias toward compact, training-distribution-favored conformations. Hybrid alignments combining synthetic and natural MSA segments enable targeted steering toward specific conformational states. These results suggest synthetic MSAs as a generalizable framework for dissecting the conformational landscapes encoded by deep learning structure predictors, with direct implications for understanding model behavior and accessing biologically relevant hidden states. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Newly generated data can be found on https://zenodo.org/records/20916910. The code underlying this article is available in GitHub at https://github.com/ibmm-unibe-ch/msa-tests. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: Using the DNA language model, GROVER, to parse effects of sequence, chromatin and regulatory features on genome stability
summary_zh: 研究利用DNA语言模型GROVER分析序列、染色质和调控特征对基因组稳定性的影响。实验发现GC富集序列与DNA双链断裂热点相关。模型预测整合序列和基因组生物特征的最佳性能。
summary_en: Research uses the DNA language model GROVER to analyze the effects of sequence, chromatin, and regulatory features on genome stability. Experiments show that GC-rich sequences are associated with DNA double-strand break hotspots. Models predict the best performance by integrating sequence and genome biological features.
insights: 创新点：DNA语言模型GROVER在基因组稳定性研究中的应用
方法亮点：利用GROVER预测DNA双链断裂位置
关键发现：序列和基因组生物特征的整合提高预测性能
insights_en: Novelty: Application of the DNA language model GROVER in genome stability research
Method highlight: Utilizing GROVER to predict DNA double-strand break locations
Key finding: Integration of sequence and genome biological features improves predictive performance
abstract: MOTIVATION: Genome stability is shaped by DNA sequence and chromatin context, but their relative contributions to double-strand break (DSB) sensitivity remain unclear. RESULTS: We show that the DNA language model, GROVER, can infer DSB location based on sequence. DSB hotspots tend to contain GC-rich sequences that belong to promoters, genes and short interspersed nuclear elements (SINEs). Additionally, we identified several specific short sequences (tokens) that are associated with modulating DSB sensitivity. Another model using chromatin and genome regulatory features outperforms the sequence-only model, highlighting complementary and cell-type specific information. Integrating sequence and genome biological features yields the best performance, demonstrating their synergy. Analyzing this model revealed that, dependent on the sample, genome stability information encoded in H3K36me3 and DNase-seq can be learned from the sequence, but not H3K27ac or H3K9me3. Embedding chromatin data directly into the GROVER architecture enabled cell-type specific modeling with performance matching the full chromatin feature model. Our results suggest that while chromatin and regulatory context provides important information, such as cell-type specificity, much of the information shaping DSB patterns is already encoded in the DNA sequence itself. Our integrative modeling approach not only reveals DSB patterns but also provides a generalizable strategy for tracing predictions in genomic data. AVAILABILITY: Data, models, and a tutorial are available on Zenodo. MODELS AND SCRIPTS: doi:10.5281/zenodo.16375950. TUTORIAL: doi:10.5281/zenodo.21131569. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: MicroRNA-34a suppresses KLF2 to promote pathological angiogenesis through the CXCR4/CXCL12 pathway in age-related macular degeneration
summary_zh: 研究揭示miR-34a通过CXCR4/CXCL12通路抑制KLF2促进年龄相关性黄斑变性中的病理性血管生成。实验发现miR-34a直接靶向并抑制KLF2。模型预测miR-34a在病理性血管生成中的关键作用。
summary_en: Research reveals that miR-34a suppresses KLF2 to promote pathological angiogenesis through the CXCR4/CXCL12 pathway in age-related macular degeneration. Experiments show that miR-34a directly targets and inhibits KLF2. Models predict the key role of miR-34a in pathological angiogenesis.
insights: 创新点：miR-34a在年龄相关性黄斑变性病理性血管生成中的作用
方法亮点：通过小鼠模型研究miR-34a的影响
关键发现：miR-34a通过CXCR4/CXCL12通路促进病理性血管生成
insights_en: Novelty: The role of miR-34a in pathological angiogenesis in age-related macular degeneration
Method highlight: Investigating the impact of miR-34a using a murine model
Key finding: miR-34a promotes pathological angiogenesis through the CXCR4/CXCL12 pathway
abstract: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD), characterized by pathologic choroidal neovascularization (CNV), is a leading cause of vision loss in the elderly. Vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFa) antagonists can prevent acute vision loss, but high treatment burden and loss of efficacy with chronic therapy highlight the need to explore alternative mechanisms. Recently, microRNA-34a (miR-34a) has emerged as a key regulator in aging and age-related diseases, but its role in neovascular AMD is unclear. In an injury-induced murine CNV model, we discovered miR-34a promoted pathological angiogenesis, without altering expression of Vegfa or its receptor Kdr, the canonical regulators of CNV. Mechanistically, miR-34a directly targets and inhibits the transcription factor KLF2 thereby upregulating the pro-angiogenic factors CXCR4 and CXCL12. Finally, we show miR-34a exacerbates CNV in aged mice and is expressed in CNV lesions excised from wet AMD patients. These findings establish a causal link between the age-related miR-34a and neovascularization in AMD. Teaser: Identification of a molecular mechanism involved in the pathogenesis of a prevalent and debilitating age-related ocular disease.

title: Therapeutic remodeling of the tuberculosis granuloma with 1-methyl-D-tryptophan enhances CD8 <sup>+</sup> T cell–macrophage interactions
summary_zh: 研究利用1-甲基-D-色氨酸治疗结核病肉芽肿，增强CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞相互作用。实验发现D-1MT治疗与显著增加T细胞浸润相关。模型预测D-1MT在结核病治疗中的潜在作用。
summary_en: Research uses 1-methyl-D-tryptophan to therapeutically remodel the tuberculosis granuloma, enhancing CD8+ T cell-macrophage interactions. Experiments show that D-1MT treatment corresponds with significantly increased T cell infiltration. Models predict the potential therapeutic role of D-1MT in tuberculosis treatment.
insights: 创新点：1-甲基-D-色氨酸在结核病治疗中的应用
方法亮点：利用高维成像技术分析肉芽肿结构
关键发现：D-1MT治疗增强CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Application of 1-methyl-D-tryptophan in tuberculosis treatment
Method highlight: Utilizing high-dimensional imaging to analyze granuloma structure
Key finding: D-1MT treatment enhances CD8+ T cell-macrophage interactions
abstract: Abstract Granulomas, the hallmark of tuberculosis (TB) disease, can both restrict Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) dissemination and impede its clearance. Recent studies indicate that indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase (IDO1), an immunosuppressive metabolic enzyme, limits infiltration of activated T cells and can contribute to TB disease progression. Treatment with 1-methyl-D-tryptophan (D-1MT), a small molecule inhibitor that restores mTOR signaling, has been shown to improve immune responses Mtb -infected rhesus macaques. Here, we investigated the impact of D-1MT treatment on TB granuloma architecture using 30-plex high-dimensional issue imaging in rhesus macaques. By spatially mapping 13 distinct cell populations, we found D-1MT treatment corresponded with significantly increased infiltration CD8 + T cells into granulomas compared to untreated controls. Notably, these CD8 + T cells expressed markers of cell proliferation and cytotoxicity. D-1MT enhanced CD8 + T cell infiltration throughout the granuloma, with particularly pronounced effects in the myeloid core, where we observed significantly enhanced spatial interactions between macrophages and CD8 + , but not CD4 + T cells. Our results demonstrate that: (i) effective intra-granulomatous Mtb control is associated with the close spatial proximity between CD8 + T cells and macrophages, a feature less abundant in uncontrolled pulmonary TB; (ii) IDO1 induction blocks CD8 + T cell infiltration and reduces T cell activation and proliferation; and (iii) therapeutic strategies, including D-1MT, that improve intra-granulomatous killing hold strong translational potential. Significance statement Our understanding of immune mechanisms within the TB granuloma has advanced greatly with the advent of high-resolution single cell multiplexed imaging. Using such imaging, we show that TB granulomas in rhesus macaques, a highly translational model of human TB pathology, are characterized by IDO1-mediated immunoregulation. Early pharmacologic restoration of mTOR signaling via D-1MT treatment can reduce IDO1 enzymatic activity and facilitate the recruitment and function of CD8 + T cells within the granulomas. These findings reveal specific mechanisms exploited by Mtb to maintain intra-granuloma persistence and underscore immune responses. Future vaccine and therapeutic design should consider these immunoregulatory features to achieve better control of Mtb infection.

title: Lifestyles of Gypsy -family transposons shape their regulatory mechanisms
summary_zh: 研究Gypsy转座子跨物种进化模式。方法：分析LTR逆转录转座子。结果显示：LTR逆转录转座子分为生殖细胞和体细胞类型。
summary_en: This study investigates the cross-species evolutionary patterns of Gypsy-family transposons. Methods: Analyzing LTR retrotransposons. Results: LTR retrotransposons are broadly separated into germline-active retroelements and gonadal soma-expressing insect endogenous retroviruses.
insights: 跨物种进化模式首次揭示
LTR逆转录转座子分类明确
生殖细胞与体细胞类型差异分析
insights_en: Novel cross-species evolutionary patterns revealed
Clear classification of LTR retrotransposons
Differences between germline and soma cell types analyzed
abstract: ABSTRACT Transposable elements are a highly diverse group of selfish genomic elements, prevalent across the tree of life, whose uncontrolled propagation poses a threat to genome stability. Recent studies have explored the evolution of Drosophila melanogaster transposable elements, their co-evolution with the host genome, and mechanisms that regulate their activity. However, little is known about their cross-species evolutionary patterns. Long terminal repeat (LTR) retrotransposons are the most active group of transposable elements in Drosophila . They are broadly separated into retroelements, which are active in the germline, and insect endogenous retroviruses that express in the gonadal soma. Somatic elements are hypothesised to infect the germline through their acquisition of virus-derived proteins such as Envelope and sORF2, thus multiplying through successive generations. In this study, we curated the sequences of LTR retrotransposons in 249 drosophilid genomes, allowing us to study their evolution across these species and highlight their varying degrees of conservation. Furthermore, we reveal multiple instances of Envelope protein loss or inactivation that suggest shifts in the expression pattern of these transposons, likely accompanied by adopting different transcriptional control mechanisms. We contrast this with the evolutionary history of sORF2, which we found to be much more stable. Lastly, we examined variations in transposon LTR regions responsible for transcriptional regulation and use predictive modelling to suggest six transcription factors likely involved in their tissue-specific expression. Altogether, we reveal complex, interspecies evolutionary patterns of Gypsy -family LTR retrotransposons and highlight examples of their coevolution with their host genome.

title: TBC1D23–AAVR interaction drives endosome-to-TGN trafficking required for rAAV transduction
summary_zh: 研究TBC1D23与AAVR相互作用。方法：通过GST-AAVR-C筛选AAVR结合蛋白。结果显示：TBC1D23通过AAVR-C介导AAV内吞体到TGN转运。
summary_en: This study investigates the interaction between TBC1D23 and AAVR. Methods: Identifying AAVR-interacting host proteins using GST-AAVR-C pulldown. Results: TBC1D23 binds AAVR via AAVR-C and mediates AAV endosome-to-trans-Golgi network translocation.
insights: TBC1D23与AAVR相互作用机制发现
AAVR-C在AAV内吞体转运中的作用明确
AAV转导过程新机制揭示
insights_en: Interaction mechanism between TBC1D23 and AAVR discovered
Role of AAVR-C in endosome trafficking clarified
New mechanism of AAV transduction revealed
abstract: Abstract The adeno-associated virus receptor (AAVR; also known as KIAA0319L) is the proteinaceous receptor required for the transduction of multi-serotype adeno-associated viruses (AAVs). While the extracellular polycystic kidney disease (PKD) domains of AAVR directly bind AAV capsids, the function of its C-terminal cytosolic domain (AAVR-C) in governing AAV internalization and intracellular trafficking remains undefined. Using targeted pulldown of AAVR-interacting host proteins with a glutathione S-Transferase (GST)-fused AAVR-C recombinant protein (GST-AAVR-C) as a bait, we identified that TBC1 domain family member 23 (TBC1D23), a specialized intracellular trafficking adaptor and bridging factor, binds AAVR via the AAVR-C and mediates AAV’s endosome-to- trans -Golgi network (TGN) transport. Biolayer interferometry (BLI) demonstrates nanomolar-affinity binding between AAVR-C and the C-terminal scaffold domain of TBC1D23 (TBC1D23-C). CRISPR-mediated knockout of TBC1D23 severely impairs rAAV transduction across multiple human cell types, including polarized human airway epithelium (HAE). Loss of TBC1D23 disrupts convergence of internalized AAV capsids at the TGN, leading to diminished nuclear import of AAV vectors. Mutational analyses of AAVR-C reveal that its acidic residue cluster is required for TBC1D23 binding and AAV retrograde transport from the endosome to the TGN. Together, these findings define TBC1D23 as a receptor-proximal trafficking module that couples AAV-AAVR engagement to vesicle transport, revealing a missing core regulatory step in AAV retrograde transport that is essential for productive rAAV transduction. Significance Recombinant adeno-associated viruses (rAAVs) are widely used gene delivery vectors, yet the intracellular trafficking steps that enable productive transduction remain incompletely defined. We identify TBC1D23 as a critical host adaptor that directly binds the cytosolic tail of the AAV receptor (AAVR) and mediates retrograde transport of AAV vectors from endosomes to the trans -Golgi network (TGN). Disruption of the AAVR acidic residue cluster abolishes TBC1D23 binding, blocks TGN trafficking, impairs nuclear import, and severely reduces transduction across multiple serotypes and in polarized human airway epithelium. These findings reveal a receptor-proximal trafficking checkpoint essential for rAAV gene delivery and define a host–vector interface with potential for rational vector engineering and therapeutic modulation.

title: Associations between county-level racial attitude bias and disparities in Advanced Placement participation
summary_zh: 研究县级行政区域种族态度偏见与AP参与差异。方法：结合Project Implicit和AP参与数据。结果显示：种族偏见与AP参与差异相关。
summary_en: This research investigates the association between county-level racial attitude bias and disparities in Advanced Placement (AP) participation. Methods: Combining Project Implicit bias measures with AP participation data. Results: Racial bias is associated with disparities in AP participation.
insights: 种族偏见与AP参与差异关联发现
Project Implicit数据与AP数据结合分析
县级行政区域偏见影响分析
insights_en: Association between racial bias and AP participation disparities discovered
Analysis combining Project Implicit and AP data
Analysis of bias impact at the county level
abstract: While much attention has been paid to racial disparities in basic academic attainment, relatively less attention is given to racial disparities in excellence—participation in and performance within opportunities to develop and demonstrate high achievement. The present research investigates how racial attitude bias relates to disparities in participation in the Advanced Placement (AP) program, a paradigmatic opportunity for excellence in the US education system. We examined whether regional racial attitude biases are associated with Black–White AP participation disparities by combining implicit and explicit pro-White/anti-Black bias measures from Project Implicit with AP participation data from the Civil Rights Data Collection. County-level implicit and explicit racial biases—among White residents overall, and White teachers specifically—were consistently and positively associated with Black–White disparities in AP course enrollment, but this was not the case for AP exam taking and passing. Importantly, the relationships between racial attitude bias and enrollment disparities remained after accounting for disparities in AP access and academic achievement prior to high school. These findings highlight the importance of identifying additional processes through which community members’ racial attitude biases may deter Black students from participating in the AP program and other opportunities for excellence.

title: Cryptic small-molecule binding sites in the ARID1B DNA-binding domain
summary_zh: 研究ARID1B DNA结合域的小分子结合位点。方法：分子动力学模拟和NMR筛选。结果显示：ARID1B具有潜在的结合位点。
summary_en: This study investigates cryptic small-molecule binding sites in the ARID1B DNA-binding domain. Methods: Molecular dynamics simulations and NMR screening. Results: ARID1B exhibits significant conformational dynamics exposing a potentially ligandable site.
insights: ARID1B结合位点新发现
分子动力学模拟揭示动态变化
NMR筛选确定结合化合物
insights_en: Novel binding site discovery in ARID1B
Molecular dynamics simulations reveal conformational dynamics
NMR screening identifies binding compounds
abstract: Genetic depletion of ARID1B has been shown to act in a synthetically lethal manner to selectively kill cancer cells with mutations in the tumor suppressor ARID1A, one of the most frequently altered proteins in human cancer. However, no precision therapeutic targeting ARID1B in ARID1A-mutant cancer has been developed due to the lack of a classically druggable small-molecule binding pocket on ARID1B. Here, we carried out molecular dynamics simulations on the small, globular AT-rich Interaction Domain (ARID) DNA-binding domain of ARID1B, demonstrating that the ARID exhibits significant conformational dynamics that expose a potentially ligandable site on the small domain. 2D protein-detected NMR fragment screening then allowed us to identify two compounds that bind to the ARID1B ARID with slow kinetics, suggestive of binding to a low-population conformation of the protein. X-ray structures of the ARID1B ARID bound to the compounds or close analogues demonstrated that they bind to two distinct cryptic pockets in the protein, exposed through different conformational rearrangements that reveal druggable sites absent in the ground state of the protein. Despite the high sequence homology between the ARID1A and ARID1B ARIDs, both cryptic pockets support selective binding to ARID1B, in one case greater than 140-fold, providing an avenue toward selectively targeting ARID1B in ARID1A-mutant cancer.

title: Tariff policy and why economics needs intergroup psychology
Burton H. Singer (1938–2026): A legacy across disciplines
summary_zh: 纪念Burton H. Singer，跨学科贡献者。方法：回顾其学术生涯。结果显示：Singer在多学科领域有卓越贡献。
summary_en: This paper commemorates Burton H. Singer, a multidisciplinary contributor. Methods: Reviewing his academic career. Results: Singer made outstanding contributions across multiple disciplines.
insights: Singer跨学科贡献回顾
学术生涯回顾方法
多学科贡献总结
insights_en: Review of Singer's multidisciplinary contributions
Method of reviewing academic career
Summary of multidisciplinary contributions
abstract: Burton Singer, elected to the National Academy of Sciences in 1994 and the National Academy of Medicine in 2005, died on February 15, 2026, at age 87. Moving seamlessly across statistics, epidemiology, economics, demography, ecology, and public health, his career transcended conventional academic boundaries. He brought the rigor of stochastic process theory to problems ranging from labor market dynamics and demographic change to tropical disease epidemiology, public health policy, and environmental stewardship. He founded the Yale School of Public Health, chaired the National Research Council’s Committee on National Statistics, and led tropical disease research governance for the World Health Organization. Yet colleagues recall his adventurous spirit, indefatigable generosity, and irreverent humor as vividly as his accomplishments.

title: Odor tracking in flying Drosophila requires visual reafference and compass neurons
summary_zh: 研究飞行果蝇嗅觉追踪的神经机制。方法：使用磁悬浮系统和数字视觉夹具。结果显示：视觉反馈对嗅觉追踪至关重要。
summary_en: This study investigates the neural mechanisms of odor tracking in flying Drosophila. Methods: Using a magnetic tether system and a digital visual clamp. Results: Visual feedback is crucial for odor tracking.
insights: 视觉反馈对嗅觉追踪重要性发现
磁悬浮系统和数字视觉夹具应用
视觉和嗅觉信号整合机制
insights_en: Discovery of the importance of visual feedback for odor tracking
Application of magnetic tether system and digital visual clamp
Mechanism of visual and olfactory signal integration
abstract: Flying Drosophila critically depend on high-contrast visual surroundings to localize odor sources in still air, yet the neural mechanisms of visual integration for active odor tracking are unknown. We demonstrate that Ellipsoid body-Protocerebral bridge-Gall (E-PG) neurons—head direction cells in the central complex—work in concert with self-generated visual motion signals to maintain a stable heading metric during olfactory navigation in flight. Using a magnetic tether system and a digital “visual clamp,” we show that removing the visual feedback generated by a fly’s own turns (reafference) causes the animal to lose its heading within an odor plume. Thus, olfactory and mechanosensory signals alone are insufficient for plume stabilization. E-PG neurons have been shown to store visual changes in heading during flight. Genetically hyperpolarizing E-PG neurons significantly compromised the flies’ ability to both acquire and maintain heading toward a food odor. Notably, silencing these neurons did not disrupt basic visual reflexes, such as optomotor gaze stabilization or object tracking, indicating a specific role in odor-directed visual navigation rather than visual flight control. While odor was found to modulate the frequency and amplitude of turns independently, E-PG neurons are essential for directing the orientation of corrective saccades toward the plume center. These results establish that visual reafference engages the internal visual compass and associated control circuits to sustain a spatial working memory of heading changes between saccades, allowing flies to maintain a straight course and navigate effectively toward an invisible odor source in flight in still air.

title: Mapping the architecture of protein complexes in Arabidopsis using cross-linking mass spectrometry
summary_zh: 研究拟南芥蛋白复合物结构。方法：使用优化交叉连接质谱流程。结果显示：定义了3083个蛋白-蛋白相互作用。
summary_en: This study maps the architecture of protein complexes in Arabidopsis using cross-linking mass spectrometry. Methods: Using an optimized cross-linking mass spectrometry workflow. Results: Defined 3,083 protein-protein interactions.
insights: 拟南芥蛋白复合物结构解析
优化交叉连接质谱技术应用
蛋白-蛋白相互作用定义
insights_en: Structure of Arabidopsis protein complexes elucidated
Application of optimized cross-linking mass spectrometry technology
Definition of protein-protein interactions
abstract: Capturing molecular machines in action is essential for understanding protein complex architecture, cellular regulation, and gene function. Here, we present a large-scale structural proteomics resource for Arabidopsis thaliana generated using an optimized cross-linking mass spectrometry workflow. Using the trifunctional cross-linker PhoX, whose phosphonic acid moiety enables immobilized metal affinity chromatography-based enrichment, we selectively enriched cross-linked peptides from whole-cell lysates, chloroplasts, and nuclei. Analysis with pLink 3.2 identified 52,944 unique cross-linked peptide pairs, corresponding to 37,531 residue-level contacts across 5,064 proteins. These data define 3,083 protein–protein interactions, including 2,385 heteromeric and 698 homomultimeric interactions. Comparison with the Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interacting Genes/Proteins (STRING) database showed that 676 interactions are supported by STRING scores ≥0.9. Structural mapping to Protein Data Bank and AlphaFold models showed that most cross-links were within the expected 35 Å distance constraint. The dataset further enabled the analysis of protein connectivity and complex topology across diverse molecular assemblies, including the Rubisco holoenzyme, chloroplast 70S ribosome, photosystem complexes, and the cytosolic 80S ribosome together with associated biogenesis and regulatory factors. We also identified histone-associated complexes, including interactions involving an O-acyltransferase. By providing residue-level structural constraints for a substantial portion of the Arabidopsis proteome, this study provides a resource for exploring plant molecular machines and their spatial organization.

title: The relationship between officer misconduct and convictionless arrests
summary_zh: 研究警察不当行为与无定罪逮捕的关系。方法：使用芝加哥警察局轮班日历。结果显示：不当行为警察更可能进行无定罪逮捕。
summary_en: This paper examines the relationship between officer misconduct and convictionless arrests. Methods: Using the Chicago Police Department's rotational duty calendar. Results: Officers with misconduct are more likely to make convictionless arrests.
insights: 不当行为与无定罪逮捕关联发现
轮班日历作为工具使用
法律参与者对逮捕的纠正
insights_en: Association between misconduct and convictionless arrests discovered
Rotational duty calendar used as a tool
Correction of arrests by downstream legal actors
abstract: This paper examines whether officers with high prior alleged misconduct are more likely to make convictionless arrests (arrests that result in no or dismissed charges or where the defendant is found not guilty). Using the Chicago Police Department’s rotational duty calendar to obtain plausibly exogenous variation in the set of officers assigned to work on a particular day, we find that high-misconduct officers make statistically significantly more arrests for nonindex crimes and in situations involving high officer discretion, compared to their no-misconduct peers. Our findings also suggest that downstream legal actors, such as prosecutors and judges, may be partially “correcting” these arrests.

title: A solution to generalized learning from small training sets found in infants’ repeated visual experiences of individual objects
summary_zh: 研究婴儿通过重复视觉经验学习个体对象类别。利用婴儿餐时头部摄像机图像，分析类别实例频率和视觉经验变异性。结果显示婴儿视觉经验频率分布高度偏斜。
summary_en: This study investigates how infants learn object categories through repeated visual experiences. Using head-cam images from meal times, we analyze the frequency of category instances and variability in visual experiences, revealing highly skewed frequency distributions.
insights: 创新点：婴儿可从少量实例中快速形成和泛化类别
方法亮点：通过头部摄像机图像分析婴儿日常视觉经验
关键发现：婴儿视觉经验频率分布高度偏斜
insights_en: Novelty: Infants rapidly form and generalize categories from few exemplars
Method highlight: Analyzing infants' daily visual experiences using head-cam images
Key finding: Highly skewed frequency distributions of visual experiences
abstract: One-year-old infants rapidly form and generalize categories from idiosyncratic experiences of very few exemplars of those categories. Here we provide evidence on the statistics of infants’ daily-life visual experiences for 8 object categories. Using a corpus of infant head-camera images recorded at mealtimes (87 mealtimes,14 infants), we measure the frequency of the unique instances of each category and the variability of the visual experiences within and across instances of the same category. The frequency distributions of instances for individual infants are highly skewed, containing many images of the same few objects along with fewer images of other instances. Graph theoretic measures of individual category experiences for individual children reveal a “lumpy” mix of high similarity and high variability, organized into multiple but interconnected clusters of high-similarity images. In computational experiments, we show that artificially created training sets characterized by an interconnected mix of high and low similarity support generalization to novel instances after limited training. We discuss implications for category recognition, and for learning more generally, by both humans and machines.

title: Canon enables causal inference of downstream genes in single-cell CRISPR studies via instrumental variable analysis
summary_zh: 提出一种基于因果推断的框架，利用gRNA扰动状态作为工具变量进行IV分析，以识别受扰动目标基因影响的下游基因。
summary_en: We introduce a causal inference-based framework that leverages the perturbation status of gRNAs as instrumental variables for IV analysis to identify downstream genes influenced by perturbed target genes.
insights: 创新点：利用工具变量分析进行因果推断
方法亮点：将gRNA扰动状态作为工具变量
关键发现：识别受扰动目标基因影响的下游基因
insights_en: Novelty: Causal inference via instrumental variable analysis
Method highlight: Using gRNA perturbation status as instrumental variables
Key finding: Identification of downstream genes influenced by perturbed target genes
abstract: A critical analytical task in sc-CRISPR screening is identifying downstream genes influenced by perturbed target genes. Existing methods for this task primarily rely on traditional association-based analyses, which not only fall short in establishing causal relationships between genes but also suffer from high false positive rates and limited statistical power. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a causal inference-based framework that leverages the perturbation status of gRNAs in single cells as instrumental variables (IVs) to infer causal gene relationship via IV analysis. Building upon this framework, we further present Canon, a one-sample IV analysis method specifically tailored to systematically identify genes that are potentially causally influenced by perturbed target genes across diverse sc-CRISPR platforms. Canon ensures robust type I error control while maintaining high statistical power. We evaluated its performance through comprehensive simulations and real data applications. The gene–gene relationships identified by Canon provide valuable insights into the causal gene regulatory network, uncovering candidate therapeutic targets with potential relevance for cancer biology and demonstrating the transformative potential of sc-CRISPR screening to resolve causal regulatory networks at an unprecedented scale.

title: Chromosomal inversions accelerate genetic evolution and drive ecological speciation across an island gradient
summary_zh: 研究染色体倒位如何加速遗传进化并驱动岛屿梯度上的生态分化。通过染色体组装和种群基因组学分析，发现基因组分化集中于特定的大规模倒位。
summary_en: This study investigates how chromosomal inversions accelerate genetic evolution and drive ecological speciation across an island gradient. Chromosome-level assemblies and population genomics reveal that genomic divergence is concentrated within specific large-scale inversions.
insights: 创新点：染色体倒位加速遗传进化
方法亮点：染色体组装和种群基因组学分析
关键发现：基因组分化集中于特定的大规模倒位
insights_en: Novelty: Chromosomal inversions accelerate genetic evolution
Method highlight: Chromosome-level assemblies and population genomics
Key finding: Genomic divergence concentrated in specific large-scale inversions
abstract: Chromosomal rearrangements are hypothesized to facilitate speciation by suppressing recombination in locally adapted genomic regions, yet how they shape evolutionary rates during rapid divergence remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the genomic architecture of two sister Carex (Cyperaceae) species on Réunion Island, which rapidly diverged (∼0.5 Mya) to occupy contrasting tropical-montane and dry-subalpine habitats. Using chromosome-level assemblies and population genomics, we show that genomic divergence is not uniform across the genome but is concentrated within specific large-scale inversions. Crucially, genes within these structural variants exhibit significantly accelerated rates of protein evolution, as evidenced by elevated ω, compared to the collinear genome. This is consistent with recombination suppression and subsequent relaxation of purifying selection driving these patterns, which may complement or even outweigh the signal of positive selection. Functional analysis and environmental associations reveal that these “genomic accelerators” include key adaptive loci: Inversions on chromosomes 14 and 28 are enriched for mechanosensitive ion channels and auxin transport, which is consistent with facilitating the interspecific physiological shift to aridity. Partial redundancy analyses reveal that ongoing intraspecific ecological adaptation is highly polygenic across the collinear genome. Our results demonstrate that genomic architecture actively dictates evolutionary speed, suggesting that certain lineages boosted by structural variants may bypass the typical constraints of purifying selection to rapidly exploit vacant ecological opportunities.

title: Evolution of human IL4I1 preference for aromatic amino acids from a broad-specificity L-amino acid oxidase ancestor
summary_zh: 研究人类IL4I1对芳香族氨基酸的偏好如何从广谱特异性的L-氨基酸氧化酶祖先进化而来。通过祖先序列重建和比较，揭示了进化过程中的变化。
summary_en: This study investigates how the human IL4I1 preference for aromatic amino acids evolved from a broad-specificity L-amino acid oxidase ancestor. Ancestral sequence reconstruction and comparison reveal changes during evolution.
insights: 创新点：研究IL4I1的进化过程
方法亮点：祖先序列重建和比较
关键发现：IL4I1进化过程中的变化
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating the evolutionary process of IL4I1
Method highlight: Ancestral sequence reconstruction and comparison
Key finding: Changes during the evolutionary process of IL4I1
abstract: IL4I1, a human L-amino acid oxidase (LAAO), has drawn considerable interest for its role in catabolism with implications for cancer biology and immune modulation. The function and activity of this enzyme in humans contrast with the cytotoxic effects exerted by LAAOs from snake venoms. The inherent instability of IL4I1 has hindered detailed biochemical characterization and its exploration as a drug target. In this study, we present a comprehensive biochemical and structural investigation of tetrapod LAAOs, with a focus on human IL4I1 and its evolutionary relationship to venomous snake proteins. By exploiting ancestral sequence reconstruction, we inferred, expressed, and characterized the tetrapodal ancestral LAAO and mammalian ancestral IL4I1 and compared their properties to recombinant human IL4I1 purified from human cells. The tetrapodal ancestor displays a broad substrate profile, acting on hydrophobic, polar, and positively charged amino acids, whereas human IL4I1 prefers aromatic amino acids. Guided by crystal structures, we engineered eight ancestral protein variants to mimic mammalian- and snake-like active site configurations. Kinetic analyses of these variants reveal distinct evolutionary trajectories: one leading to the high-activity venomous LAAOs of reptiles, and another to the aromatic-selective IL4I1 of mammals. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the functional divergence between human IL4I1 and venomous snake LAAOs is underpinned by evolutionary shifts in substrate specificity and catalytic efficiency.

title: A quantitative model of a phenotypically variable genetic defect
summary_zh: 以果蝇气管系统终端细胞指定为模型，研究遗传缺陷的表型变异性。通过扰动FGF配体剂量，发现微环境和随机效应对终端细胞指定的影响。
summary_en: We establish the specification of terminal cells in the Drosophila tracheal system as a model for phenotypic variability in genetic defects. Perturbing FGF ligand dosage reveals the influence of microenvironmental and stochastic effects on terminal cell specification.
insights: 创新点：建立遗传缺陷表型变异性的定量模型
方法亮点：扰动FGF配体剂量研究终端细胞指定
关键发现：微环境和随机效应对终端细胞指定的影响
insights_en: Novelty: A quantitative model for phenotypic variability in genetic defects
Method highlight: Perturbing FGF ligand dosage to study terminal cell specification
Key finding: Influence of microenvironmental and stochastic effects on terminal cell specification
abstract: Phenotypic variability is a hallmark of human disease. It results from a combination of genetic modifiers, environment, and stochastic effects, but their contributions are hard to disentangle. Here, we establish the specification of terminal cells in the Drosophila tracheal system as a model for phenotypic variability and phenotypic emergence in Mendelian disorders. By perturbing Fibroblast growth factor (FGF) ligand dosage, which leads to a loss of terminal cells, we find that both microenvironmental and stochastic effects contribute to variability in terminal cell specification. We demonstrate that the phenotype results from reduced Ras-ERK signaling and use live imaging to identify molecular and morphological features of successful and failed terminal cell specification. Finally, using liability-threshold modeling, we quantify the relative magnitudes of genetic perturbations, microenvironmental effects, and stochasticity, establishing a strategy for dissecting the origins of phenotypic variability.

title: Correction for Peng et al., An Octopus probe for high-performance >1,300 nm NIR-II fluorescence molecular imaging of cancer
Decision rules diverge between sympatric Featherfin cichlids despite shared preferences, ecology, and evolutionary history
summary_zh: 研究同域Featherfin鲈鱼尽管有共享偏好、生态和进化历史，决策规则仍存在差异。通过野外认知实验，发现决策策略的系统性差异。
summary_en: This study investigates the divergence in decision rules between sympatric Featherfin cichlids despite shared preferences, ecology, and evolutionary history. Field cognitive experiments reveal systematic differences in decisional strategies.
insights: 创新点：研究同域物种决策规则的差异
方法亮点：野外认知实验研究决策策略
关键发现：决策策略的系统性差异
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating decision rule divergence in sympatric species
Method highlight: Field cognitive experiments to study decisional strategies
Key finding: Systematic differences in decisional strategies
abstract: It has been hypothesized that divergence in animal decision processes can be attributed to differences in information processing mechanisms. However, the required comparative tests of this idea are hindered by ecological, perceptual, or motivational divergence among species that confound a direct analysis of decision processes. To overcome these limitations, we study two closely related, sympatric cichlid fishes ( Aulonocranus dewindti and Cyathopharynx furcifer ) that share visual capacities, ecological context and object-removal motivations, and we perform a systematic assessment of decisional strategy divergence in wild animals, using established paradigms from human psychology research. In a series of in situ field cognitive experiments in Lake Tanganyika, comprising over 5,000 trials, we first find that the two species make similar decisions under low perceptual load, with identical size and color preferences and comparable oddity effects. Yet, when task complexity increased and choices required integrating conflicting features, the species’ decisions diverged. C. furcifer made rapid, consistent decisions based on a single dominant feature, whereas A. dewindti took longer to decide and integrated all features of the options. A decoy paradigm confirmed that A. dewindti ’s primarily relied on available information. These findings show that closely related species can exhibit markedly different decision outcomes despite sharing sensory abilities, ecological context, and baseline preferences. The observed divergence is consistent with differences in prioritization and integration of information under complex conditions.

title: Hydrophobic unnatural base pair promotes trigger loop closure and catalysis in cellular RNA polymerase independent of hydrogen bonding
summary_zh: 研究疏水性非天然碱基对在细胞RNA聚合酶中促进触发环闭合和催化作用，而不依赖于氢键。
summary_en: This study investigates the role of hydrophobic unnatural base pairs in promoting trigger loop closure and catalysis in cellular RNA polymerases, independent of hydrogen bonding.
insights: 创新点：疏水性非天然碱基对在RNA聚合酶中的作用
方法亮点：研究触发环闭合和催化作用
关键发现：不依赖于氢键的催化
insights_en: Novelty: Role of hydrophobic unnatural base pairs in RNA polymerases
Method highlight: Investigating trigger loop closure and catalysis
Key finding: Catalysis independent of hydrogen bonding
abstract: Expanded genetic alphabets based on synthetic nucleotides offer a powerful strategy to increase the chemical diversity and functional potential of nucleic acids. Hydrophobic unnatural base pairs (UBPs) represent a unique class of UBPs that operate without canonical hydrogen bonding and shapes, which are distinct from natural base pairs. However, the molecular mechanisms governing hydrophobic UBP recognition and incorporation by RNA polymerases remain poorly understood, because no structures of catalytically competent state have been captured. Here, we investigate the enzyme kinetics and structural basis of transcription recognition of hydrophobic 7-(2-thienyl)-imidazo[4,5-b]pyridine (Ds):pyrrole 2-carbaldehyde (Pa) base pair by the Escherichia coli RNA polymerase ( Ec RNAP). Enzyme kinetics reveal a pronounced strand-dependent asymmetry, with DsTP incorporated substantially more efficiently than PaTP. To elucidate the structural origin of this asymmetry, we determined two cryo-electron microscopy structures of E. coli RNAP elongation complexes containing dPa:DsTP and dDs:PaTP at resolutions of 3.20 Å and 3.24 Å, respectively. The dPa:DsTP structure captures a pre-catalytic state of hydrophobic UBP transcription in which DsTP forms an edge-to-edge base pair with templating dPa, and the active site adopts a native-like, catalytically competent configuration with fully folded trigger loop. In contrast, the dDs:PaTP structure reveals a pre-insertion intermediate with incomplete substrate loading. Structural modeling indicates that PaTP must undergo an additional insertion step to achieve productive catalysis. Together, these findings define the molecular basis of asymmetric Ds:Pa UBP transcription recognition by a multisubunit RNAP and provide structural principles for designing next-generation UBPs compatible with cellular transcription.

title: Structure and dynamics of confined water in amyloid protein fibril nanochannels
summary_zh: 研究淀粉样蛋白纤维纳米通道中限制水的结构和动态。通过分子动力学模拟，揭示序列水平变异如何影响水通道结构。
summary_en: This study investigates the structure and dynamics of confined water in amyloid protein fibril nanochannels. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal how sequence-level variation influences the structure of water channels.
insights: 创新点：淀粉样蛋白纤维纳米通道中水的结构和动态
方法亮点：分子动力学模拟研究水通道
关键发现：序列水平变异影响水通道结构
insights_en: Novelty: Structure and dynamics of water in amyloid protein fibril nanochannels
Method highlight: Molecular dynamics simulations to study water channels
Key finding: Sequence-level variation influences the structure of water channels
abstract: Many fibrils of amyloid proteins are characterized by a dense core structure that largely excludes water. However, an increasing number of amyloid fibril structures are observed to contain water channels. Although water in membrane protein channels and pores has been studied, the structure and dynamics of water in amyloid protein fibril nanochannels is largely unexplored. In this computational study, we used molecular dynamics simulations to characterize the structure and dynamics of water inside the water channels of ex vivo human Serum Amyloid A (hSAA), ex vivo murine SAA (mSAA), and ex vivo feline SAA (fSAA) fibrils. Although these proteins are highly homologous, their fibril architectures differ substantially, providing an opportunity to understand how sequence-level variation influences interior water behavior. We find that water within the channels of all three fibrils exhibits damped translational and rotational diffusion relative to bulk water and adopts distinct ordered hydrogen-bonding networks. The water in fSAA and hSAA channels hydrates interior salt-bridges and hydrogen bonds with hydrophilic side chains, suggesting a stabilizing role. Confined water in mSAA channels engages in interactions with both the side chains and backbone of the residues, showing a unique trigonal arrangement and ice-like dynamics that has not been previously reported for confined water. Our results serve to elucidate the structural and dynamical role of water in the interior of amyloid protein fibrils.

title: Recursive mentalizing and public salience in the perception of common knowledge
summary_zh: 本文研究共同知识的感知，方法上结合递归心理化和公共显著性感知。实验表明，公开见证事件时，人们推断递归信念被许可。
summary_en: This paper studies the perception of common knowledge, combining recursive mentalizing with a sense of public salience. Experiments show that when events are jointly witnessed, people infer that recursively embedded beliefs are licensed.
insights: 创新点：共同知识感知结合递归心理化与公共显著性感知
方法亮点：通过虚构场景探究信念归属
关键发现：公开见证事件促进递归信念许可
insights_en: Novelty: Combining recursive mentalizing with public salience in common knowledge perception
Method highlight: Exploring belief ascriptions through fictional vignettes
Key finding: Public witnessing of events promotes licensing of recursively embedded beliefs
abstract: Common knowledge—what everyone knows that everyone knows, ad infinitum—is theoretically required for coordination. But a finite mind cannot represent infinitely embedded propositions, and even a few are cognitively taxing. We propose that people perceive common knowledge by combining a capacity-limited ability for recursive mentalizing with an intuitive sense of public salience: When an event is jointly and openly witnessed, they infer that recursively embedded beliefs are licensed. We probed participants’ attributions of embedded beliefs to characters in fictitious vignettes. Study 1 presented narratives in which the information available to characters was either asymmetrical, reciprocal, or public. Participants indicated their confidence in the characters’ beliefs with 0, 2, 4, 6, and 18 embeddings (the latter judged indirectly). Ratings showed i) a decline with number of embeddings, reflecting cognitive load, ii) modest overattribution of embedded beliefs in the nonpublic conditions, iii) far higher attribution of embedded beliefs in the public conditions, and iv) high indirect judgments that arbitrarily deep beliefs were justified. Study 2 replicated these findings with animated videos in which the characters’ information was private, reciprocal, doubly reciprocal, or public. Together, the studies indicate that people attribute common knowledge to observers of a publicly salient event, while being susceptible to capacity-driven recursion collapse and heuristic extrapolation (false embedded beliefs). This can explain how humans achieve coordination from sparse cues, yet sometimes miscoordinate when publicness is absent or embedding grows complex.

Non–US-Born Physicians in the US Internal Medicine Workforce
summary_zh: 研究估算美国内外科医生中本土与非本土毕业生的比例，以及他们照护的弱势群体患者比例。
summary_en: This study estimates the share of US-born and non-US-born US medical graduates and international medical graduates in the US internal medicine workforce, as well as the share of underserved patients cared for by these physicians.

Method highlight: Assessing the proportion of underserved patients cared for by these physicians

abstract: This study estimates the share of US-born and non–US-born US medical graduates (USMGs) and international medical graduates (IMGs) in the US internal medicine workforce, as well as the share of underserved patients cared for by these physicians.
